candidate_windows.window_text: We ran all offline models on 4 Nvidia A100 GPUs in a data parallel fashion. Explanation generation with GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 takes around 2 hours and LLaMA2 takes around 4 hours. The cost of generating explanations was $49 (US Dollar) with GPT-4 and$ 10 (US Dollar) with GPT-3.5. We present full evidence attribution results for sample setting in Table 8 and full setting in Table 11.
